name: io.github.local/mcp-chrome-metamask
description: Drive a real browser with a real wallet extension, so an agent can test a dapp end to end: connect, sign, transact, confirm.

environmentVariables.name: RIG_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Burner private key to import into the test wallet. Omit to let the wallet generate its own account. Never use a key with real funds.

environmentVariables.name: RIG_KEY_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file containing only a burner private key, as an alternative to RIG_PRIVATE_KEY.

packageArguments.name: --chain-id
packageArguments.description: Chain id to fix for this session.

packageArguments.name: --app-url
packageArguments.description: Default URL of the app under test.

packageArguments.name: --key-file
packageArguments.description: Path to a file containing only a burner key.

packageArguments.name: --headless
packageArguments.description: Run the browser without a window.

packageArguments.name: --allow-mainnet
packageArguments.description: Permit auto-approval on chains that spend real money. Off by default.
